title: Astro Portal session event payload: mount_connected
description: The application opened its link to the night's mount (any protocol: LX200, Alpaca, INDI, SynScan, iOptron, NexStar; a smart telescope in mode simplifié is driven through the same mount link). Read only: connecting never moves the mount. Recorded at the instant the link answered. Recorded by the application from the driver's own code path with the night's clock; every field but the ones marked required is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Private in a shared night. See session-events.md.

protocol.description: Optional: the mount's protocol as the application names it (`LX200`, `Alpaca`, `INDI`, `SynScan`, `iOptron`, `NexStar`).

mountName.description: Optional: the product name the mount reads out (« OnStep »).

family.description: Optional: the smart telescope's family (`seestar`, `dwarf`, `vespera`, `origin`) when the device is one.
